ownership_filter: positions/deals counted ONLY when magic in (31082026, 31082027) AND comment contains 'TB|'
daily_definition: today TB PnL = realized TB deals since UTC day start + unrealized TB-owned open PnL; % relative to frozen start-of-day account equity (freeze at first observation of the day)
deployment_definition: TB return since deployment = realized TB deals since deployment_start_epoch + unrealized open PnL; % relative to frozen deployment_start_equity; baseline persists across worker restarts / PC reboots (only a new deployment generation resets it)

foreign_magic_excluded.evidence: deal with magic 99999999 (manual) excluded from today/open/deploy PnL

same_magic_no_tag_excluded.evidence: deal with CONTROL_MAGIC but comment 'other-ea' (no TB| tag) excluded

window_filter.evidence: owned deal older than the deployment epoch excluded from deployment PnL

timezone: UTC day boundary (documented; not silently changed)
